answer.says: Good morning, Shri Hegde. The confusion of our names is still settling, but the house is yours as well as mine. Please, make yourself at home; do not let the presence of a philosopher disturb your rest.
answer.thought: The presence of the man who is supposed to own this house is a living contradiction: the universal name Hegde has been particularized into Hegel, and we both inhabit the error. I must be courteous, for the state of things requires that the individual treat the other as a person, even if the administrative machinery has failed to distinguish us properly. Ramesh’s towel on the step is a small act of practical reason, smoothing the particular friction of the morning.
